summary: DMFI PAC endorsed Marni von Wilpert (San Diego councilwoman, CA-48) as a 'strongly pro-Israel' candidate with 'great relationships and records with the community.'
quote: We think all three of these candidates are strongly pro-Israel and have great relationships and records with the community

summary: DMFI PAC confirmed its early endorsement of Marni von Wilpert under its 'Majority Project' to elect pro-Israel Democrats after she won the CA-48 primary.
quote: DMFI PAC was one of the first national organizations to endorse Marni as part of our Majority Project — an effort to elect pro-Israel Democrats and help win back the House.

summary: Marni von Wilpert received $90,731 from pro-Israel PACs in the 2026 cycle: $80K J Street PAC, $9K JACPAC, $3K DMFI PAC; $333 spent for her by DMFI PAC.
quote: Marni von Wilpert has received $90,731 from pro-Israel PACs, had $333 spent supporting them in the 2026 cycle, chiefly from J Street PAC (FEC filings through 2026-10-04)
